pairs: Will you forget me until the end?
usquequo avertis faciem tuam a me?
How long will you turn your face away from me?
quamdiu ponam consilia in anima mea;
How long can I take counsel in my soul,
dolorem in corde meo per diem?
sorrowing in my heart throughout the day?
usquequo exaltabitur inimicus meus super me?
How long will my enemy be exalted over me?
lest I fall asleep forever in death,
lest at any time my enemy may say,
Qui tribulant me exsultabunt si motus fuero;
Those who trouble me will exult, if I have been disturbed.
ego autem in misericordia tua speravi.
But I have hoped in your mercy.
Exsultabit cor meum in salutari tuo.
My heart will exult in your salvation.
Cantabo Domino qui bona tribuit mihi;
I will sing to the Lord, who assigns good things to me.
And I will sing psalms to the name of the Lord Most High.
